body:
Closes #4

Ticket: [ALBUM-4](https://github.com/dbeallor/album-ranker/issues/4). Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-21-album-4-data-model-storage.md`. Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-21-album-4-data-model-storage.md`.

## What this adds

- SQLite storage on Node's built-in `node:sqlite`, no new dependency and no ORM.
- Numbered SQL migrations (`lib/db/migrations/001_initial.sql`) with a runner, applied on first open or with `npm run db:migrate`.
- Six tables: artists, albums, year entries, matchups, decade list entries, import review items. Only inputs are stored.
- A data access layer in `lib/db/` that enforces the spec's rules (one year entry per album, unique ranks, rank matches placement, decade list eligibility and follow-along removal, undo, cascade deletes, manual album linking).
- README step for `npm run db:migrate`.

No screens or routes.

## Proof

- **Year entry CRUD, second entry and duplicate rank rejected**: `lib/db/year-entries.test.ts` passes.

  ```
  $ npm test
   Test Files  10 passed (10)
        Tests  73 passed (73) (37 of them ALBUM-4; the rest came from main)
  ```

- **Three placements, manual album linking, matchup insert and undo, decade list rules**: `albums.test.ts`, `year-entries.test.ts`, `matchups.test.ts`, `decade-lists.test.ts` in the same run.
- **Schema setup from a clean checkout**: `npm run db:migrate` with `DATABASE_PATH` in a temp folder created the folder and file, and a second run did nothing.

  ```
  $ DATABASE_PATH=$TMP/x/t.db npm run db:migrate
  Database ready at $TMP/x/t.db
  ```

- **Lint, typecheck, build**: `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` print no errors; `npm run build` succeeds.

Not proven:
- CI: the repo has no CI yet.
- The `server-only` import in `lib/db/server.ts` under a real route: nothing imports it yet.

Context size: pass skipped (not collective-wisdom)

## Code review (pass 1)

Head: be3f6c60577ef48fcb0f6e6e7e4be0ea4f4b6023

No Must fix. All seven scope rules hold in code and tests; the Proof section matches the ticket's three Acceptance items. Tests: 37 pass; `npm run db:migrate` twice on a new path is idempotent.

Should fix: the migration runner reads applied versions before `BEGIN`, so two processes opening a new database can both try migration 001 (2 of 6 runs failed with "table artists already exists").
Nits: guard `ROLLBACK`, close the handle when `migrate` throws, blank title check in `linkToCatalog`, comment on the cwd-relative migrations folder.

Verdict: PASS

## Code review (pass 2)

Head: b5d0535e03368739291865c154befecbd3aaa605

The race is fixed in b5d0535: `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` with a re-check inside the transaction, `busy_timeout` set first, a retry on the WAL switch, guarded `ROLLBACK`, handle closed when `migrate` throws, and a blank title check in `linkToCatalog`. 40 rounds of 4 parallel processes against new databases: 160 of 160 exited 0 (the old head failed 96 of 160). Tests: 37 pass.

Optional nits left: close the handle if the pragmas throw, match the SQLite error code instead of the message, skip the write lock when nothing is pending, a test for the `linkToCatalog` blank title.

Verdict: PASS

## Security review (pass 1)

Head reviewed: b5d0535e03368739291865c154befecbd3aaa605

| Severity | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| Low | `.gitignore`, `lib/db/connection.ts` | WAL mode adds `<db>-wal` and `<db>-shm` files that `*.db` doesn't ignore, so with a `DATABASE_PATH` outside `data/` they could be committed. **Fixed** by adding `*.db-*` to `.gitignore`. |
| Low | `lib/db/connection.ts` | Directory and file use the default umask. Acceptable for a single-user local app. |
| Low | `lib/db/albums.ts` (`cover_url`) | URL stored unvalidated. The ticket that renders or fetches it should allow only `https:` (XSS and SSRF). |
| Low | `lib/db/*.ts` | No length bounds on text fields. Add limits when routes accept input. |
| Info | `lib/db/*.ts` | SQL injection: clean. Every value uses `?` placeholders; the only interpolated SQL is module constants. |
| Info | `lib/db/migrate.ts` | Migration path comes from `process.cwd()` and a filename pattern; no traversal. |
| Info | `DataError` messages | Routes should return the `code` and safe text, never raw SQLite errors. |

No secrets, no `data/` folder or SQLite file in the diff; `server.ts` imports `server-only`.

Verdict: PASS

## Docs check

DOCS CHECK f22adb4 (origin/main...HEAD): 2 stale in docs/stack.md fixed, 3 in docs/agents/project.md left.
Docs checked: docs/stack.md at 32f9540
Rejected: docs/agents/project.md `lib/` and `scripts/` area text and the `Test database` and `Migrations directory` rows: the spec leaves project.md unchanged (the ticket doesn't ask for it) and lists the rows as a follow-up.

## Code review (pass 3)

Head: 50b15738b0b3eb4a61cd57c95a34ea939931fa7e

Re-review after merging `main` (ALBUM-5) into the branch. The PR diff holds only ALBUM-4 files, and the conflict resolution in `README.md` and `docs/stack.md` kept both sides (db:migrate step, `MUSICBRAINZ_USER_AGENT`, Album catalog and Database rows). Also checked: the `.gitignore` `*.db-*` line and the stack.md edits. `npm test` (73 tests), lint and typecheck pass; `npm run db:migrate` works.

Nits left: reword README step 4; Node prints a `MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON` warning on `db:migrate` (already in the as-built).

Verdict: PASS

## Security review (pass 2)

Head: 50b15738b0b3eb4a61cd57c95a34ea939931fa7e

No finding above Low. The WAL side-file gap from pass 1 is closed (`*.db-*` in `.gitignore`; `data/x.db`, `x.db-wal`, `x.db-shm`, `x.sqlite-wal` all ignored). No new dependency, no routes, no secrets, and no `data/` or SQLite file tracked. All SQL values use `?` placeholders. The merge conflict resolutions add no credentials.

Low, carried: a `DATABASE_PATH` inside the repo with an extension other than `.db` or `.sqlite*` is not ignored. A note in `.env.example` or the README would cover it.

Verdict: PASS
